sections.title: Installation Requirements From Source
points: Power must be within 1 m of the equipment.
The source describes both units as using a 2-hole power supply; voltage, connected load, plug type, socket count, and exact mounting position remain unconfirmed.
Provide a nearby drain point no more than 200 mm above finished floor; the source recommends PVC 50 drain pipe.
Bring water inlet/outlet points out at 300-500 mm above finished floor.
Arrange the water connections in the source's described 品字型 layout; an installer-approved dimensioned point-position drawing is still required because exact centre distances are not supplied.
Water inlet/outlet connection size: 6分 (3/4 inch).
Reserve more space than the machine's physical size for installation and servicing.
Do not place the machines directly under the sink.

sections.title: Cabinet and Utility Coordination
points: Reserve a separate accessible bay with at least 800 mm clear width; target 1000 mm where the kitchen plan allows.
Confirm the clear internal depth after doors, back panel, pipework, skirting, and wall deviations; the machine reference depth alone is 383 mm.
Confirm clear internal height for lid/control access, salt loading, hose bends, and lifting/removal; the machine reference height alone is 535 mm.
Do not run the sink bowl, sink waste, or routine sink leakage risk directly above the machines.
Keep sockets and electrical connections away from drain discharge and leak-prone joints, with accessible isolation and suitable protection confirmed by the electrician.
Provide accessible isolation/bypass valves and unions so either unit can be removed without cutting fixed pipework.
Verify the drain's required air gap, trap, discharge capacity, and backflow protection with the equipment installer and plumber.
Record all pipe and drain positions from finished-floor and fixed-wall datums before cabinetry production.

sections.title: Pending Before Water/Electrical Freeze
points: Itemised 套餐6 order/configuration sheet confirming the model of all four units; in particular, verify that the central units are WS-LU2L-07 and WS-LU2F-05 rather than relying only on the listing's parameter tables and reference dimensions.
Exact prefilter and point-of-use drinking-water filter models, included faucet, filter elements, adapters, and first replacement-consumable set.
Final installer schematic, flow direction, bypass and isolation valve set.
Final cabinet location and whether the 800-1000 mm width is clear internal width or module width.
Exact service clearances above, behind, beside, and in front of each unit.
Exact pipe centres for the 品字型 arrangement.
Electrical voltage, load, socket/plug specification, socket count, and installation height.
Drain flow, air-gap, trap, venting, and backflow requirements.
Whether a floor drain, leak tray, leak sensor, and automatic shutoff valve are required.
Water pressure, hardness, regeneration/salt requirements, filter replacement access, and maintenance frequency.

The purchased kitchen faucet is GROHE 31874, a standard hot/cold faucet without a dedicated filtered-water channel. Do not substitute it for the SYR package drinking-water faucet. Reserve a separate filtered-water faucet, separate opening, outlet connection, and service path; confirm exact interface and pressure characteristics with the SYR installer.

sections.title: Procurement and Site Acceptance
points: Require a pre-purchase itemised list showing every pipe, elbow, tee, coupling, valve, adapter, clamp, sleeve, and other fitting.
On arrival, photograph labels, production/batch information, dimensions, condition, and counts before installation.
Keep pipe and fitting systems compatible; do not accept mixed or unidentified substitute materials without written owner approval.
Record the completed pipe routes and joints before concealment.
Perform and document the agreed pressure test, duration, pressure readings, leak inspection, acceptance signature, and any manufacturer/installer warranty service.

sections.title: Current Installation Blocker / 当前安装受阻
points: 施工方要求物业确认拟定的外墙安装方案，并转述可能存在法规异议；物业正式答复尚未收到。

但本台日本市场机型仍然不得放行安装。须先取得外墙／共有部分同意、经认可的钻孔与固定详图、燃气安装认可、与交付完整型号匹配且可查询的 CCC 证书、明确的北京 12T 气源适配证据，以及交付整机的 220 V／变压器资料。

在解除受阻状态前：不得钻外墙、改燃气走向、挂装设备、通电或通气调试。

sections.title: Owner-Confirmed Installation Intent / 预定安装细节
points: Planned unit position: exterior side near the right side of the kitchen window.

Planned wall route: four independent passages from below the adjacent kitchen cabinetry to the exterior wall, respectively for the cold-water inlet, hot-water outlet, gas pipe and wired-controller cable.
Valve positions: cold-water, hot-water and gas isolation valves all remain indoors and must stay accessible after the cabinets are installed.

Power source: use an indoor socket. The supplier says the product has a built-in transformer; this does not by itself release a 220 V connection. Confirm that the delivered complete assembly and transformer labels explicitly accept 220 V input and verify capacity, protection and earthing before energisation. If the claim is not confirmed, an approved external conversion solution remains required.

The four routes are a layout decision only. Final hole/slot sizes, centre lines, sleeves, separation, exterior sealing, insulation and service clearances must be confirmed against the delivered unit, official manual, gas-contractor requirements and the signed cabinet drawing before drilling.

sections.title: Built-In Transformer Research / 内置变压器核查
points: The official Rinnai Japan candidate documentation identifies the heater base unit as AC 100 V. The exact-family technical manual lists approximately 36 W during normal operation and approximately 68 W when the freeze-protection heater operates.
No Rinnai Japan source found in this review documents a factory 220 V input version or a factory-integrated 220-to-100 V transformer for either seller-shown candidate model.

One Chinese marketplace listing for RUX-A1616W-E describes the product as 100 V and says a 100 W transformer is supplied. This supports the possibility of a seller-bundled conversion solution, but does not verify whether this supplier has physically integrated one into the purchased unit.

Therefore this is recorded as a supplier-installed internal conversion package, not as a verified Rinnai factory 220 V model. The arrangement is more compact than a separate outdoor transformer and is compatible with the planned indoor 220 V socket in principle, but it is not inherently safer unless the converter, enclosure, wiring and protection are documented. Obtain written confirmation of who modified it and whether waterproofing, electrical safety, gas-appliance approval and warranty remain valid.
Rinnai Japan 2026 product catalogue
Rinnai official product/manual portal — RUX-A1616W-E, item code 23-5468
Chinese same-model listing stating 100 V and supplied transformer

sections.title: Beijing Winter Valve Decision / 北京冬季阀门决定
points: Keep the cold-water inlet isolation valve indoors, near the wall penetration and continuously accessible after cabinetry is installed.

Keep the hot-water service isolation valve indoors if it is included in the final valve set. Provide a drain/bleed arrangement that can empty the outdoor cold/hot runs and the heater in accordance with the delivered manual.

Keep the primary appliance gas shut-off indoors, near the penetration and not behind a fixed or sealed cabinet panel. The gas company/qualified installer must approve its exact location and decide whether a second outdoor service valve is required at the unit.
Minimise and fully weatherproof-insulate all exterior water pipes, connections and exposed metal gaps. Indoor valves alone do not prevent the outdoor trapped water from freezing.

Preserve power to the approved freeze-protection arrangement in normal winter operation, but also provide a manual drain procedure: Rinnai states that automatic freeze protection is unavailable during a power outage or power-off mode.
Use approved fixed gas piping through the exterior wall; a flexible appliance hose must not pass through the wall.
Beijing winter water-supply freeze-protection guidance
Rinnai official water-heater freeze-protection guidance
GB 55009-2021 Gas Engineering Project Code

sections.title: Planned Outdoor-Unit Routing / 预定安装走向
points: The outdoor unit is planned near the right side of the kitchen window.
Four separate routes are to pass from the cabinet-lower zone through the exterior wall: cold-water inlet, hot-water outlet, gas pipe, and wired-controller cable.
The cold- and hot-water isolation valves are to remain indoors and accessible.
The gas shut-off valve is also to remain indoors and accessible.

Electrical power is to be taken from an indoor socket. The supplier now states that a 220-to-100 V transformer has already been added inside the supplied assembly before delivery. Treat this as a supplier-installed conversion package rather than a Rinnai factory 220 V specification unless factory documentation proves otherwise. Because both archived Japanese base-model manuals specify AC 100 V, do not energise until the complete assembly input label and the internal transformer's input/output rating confirm a safe 220 V supply arrangement, continuous capacity, protection, weather sealing and earthing.

Before drilling or cabinet fabrication, the installer, gas contractor and cabinet maker must sign off the exact penetration diameters, spacing, sleeves, weather/water sealing, pipe insulation, controller-cable separation, valve access and future service/removal route.

sections.title: Must Confirm Before Installation
points: Delivered nameplate and exact model suffix
Gas type and compatibility with the actual household pipeline gas
Legal/local acceptance of the outdoor mounting location
Manufacturer/seller installation instructions and third-party warranty conditions
Combustion and gas-tightness commissioning record
Freeze-protection power and water-drain strategy for Beijing winter conditions
Written or nameplate confirmation of the supplier-claimed built-in transformer, including 220 V input, output rating, protection and warranty responsibility

sections.title: Installation Approval Hold / 安装审批受阻
points: 施工方提出，室外机挂装及穿外墙走管需要物业认可，并转述可能存在法规异议。
物业正式答复仍在等待中。在收到书面结论及其依据之前，HomeOS 将其记录为 受阻／等待审核，不记录为已经确认违法。
在以下放行条件全部关闭前，不得钻外墙、改燃气走向、挂装设备、通电或通气调试。

sections.title: Transformer Evidence Review / 变压器资料核查
points: The archived Rinnai Japan documentation for both seller-shown candidate models specifies an AC 100 V base unit; the exact-family manual lists normal electrical consumption around 36 W and freeze-protection heater operation around 68 W.

No Rinnai Japan catalogue, product page or official installation document located in this review describes a factory-integrated 220-to-100 V transformer or approves direct 220 V input for RUX-A1616W(A)-E / RUX-A1616W-E.

A Chinese retail listing for the same RUX-A1616W-E explicitly describes the heater as 100 V and says a 100 W transformer is supplied separately. That listing does not prove the configuration of this purchased unit, but it shows that a bundled transformer is a seller-side package rather than evidence of a standard Rinnai Japan 220 V model.

Working conclusion: the supplier has clarified that the conversion module has already been installed inside the supplied assembly. This makes the planned indoor 220 V socket and outdoor-unit routing workable in principle and avoids a separate weather-exposed transformer, but it remains a supplier-installed conversion rather than an identified Rinnai factory configuration. Treat its safety and compatibility as unverified until the delivered assembly is documented.

Required arrival evidence: complete heater nameplate, overall 220 V input label if present, transformer brand/model, input/output voltage and VA/W rating, installation location/enclosure, wiring/protection diagram, earthing method and written warranty responsibility for the conversion.

sections.title: Beijing Winter Valve-Location Review / 北京冬季阀门位置结论
points: Cold-water inlet isolation: keep the valve indoors, immediately upstream of the exterior-wall route, in an accessible cabinet/service opening. This makes emergency shut-off possible without going outdoors and keeps the valve body out of Beijing freeze exposure.

Hot-water outlet isolation: if fitted for service, keep it indoors and accessible beside the cold-water valve. Confirm the final valve set and operating procedure with the installer so that the outdoor section can be drained without trapping water.

Primary appliance gas shut-off: keep it indoors near the wall route, readily reachable and not concealed behind a fixed cabinet or sealed panel. The final approved position, pipe material and any additional outdoor service valve must be confirmed by the gas company or a qualified gas contractor. Gas-valve location is governed mainly by safe access and maintenance, not water-freezing risk.

Outdoor water side remains a freeze-risk section: indoor valves do not protect the water left between those valves and the outdoor heater. Keep the exterior run as short as practicable; insulate the complete exposed cold/hot pipes, joints and metal gaps with weather- and UV-resistant protection; and provide a documented drain-down path for the outdoor pipes and heater.

Power loss is a design condition: Rinnai states that its automatic freeze protection does not operate during a power outage or power-off mode. The installation therefore needs a manual drain procedure that can be performed from an accessible position, rather than relying only on the heater's electric freeze protection.
Gas wall crossing: use the gas contractor's approved fixed piping, sleeve/seal and anti-settlement/protection details. Do not route a flexible appliance hose through the exterior wall.
Beijing winter water-supply freeze-protection guidance
Rinnai official water-heater freeze-protection guidance
GB 55009-2021 Gas Engineering Project Code, clauses 5.3.8-5.3.11 and 6.1.8

sections.title: Confirmed Ceiling and Beam Finish Scope / 施工范围

红线标注的顶面 / 梁体区域按普通天花涂装体系处理，最终做白色墙漆。

sections.title: Delivery Acceptance
points: Photograph the unopened packaging, model label, colour code (08), batch/serial information, and all accessories.
Check for impact damage, cracks, deformation, scratches, colour variation, and damaged support feet before signing.
Confirm whether the order includes any drain fitting; the official specification treats the drain fitting as separate.
Verify that delivered drainage labels match the purchased package DB601S-1B + QCHRG and retain the packing list.
Keep protective film/covering in place during construction and prohibit using the tub for mixing, washing tools, or storing debris.

sections.title: Installation Hold Points
points: Re-measure the narrowest finished opening and wall verticality before enclosing the bathtub.
Trial-fit the bathtub before surrounding wall/terrazzo closure.
Provide a flat, rigid base so all feet bear evenly; do not support the tub by its rim.
Do not backfill the bathtub shell with mortar.
Confirm direct or horizontal drainage and the exact DB505R-1A / DB505R-1B fitting before closing access.

Because the purchased package states DB601S-1B + QCHRG, do not substitute or install either drainage route until the seller and installer confirm compatibility against the delivered tub and site drain position.
Fill and leak-test the tub and drain before sealing the terrazzo face.
Retain a removable access panel near the waste connection.
Use a flexible joint and bathroom-compatible mould-resistant sealant at the rim/finish junction.

sections.title: 安装入场顺序
points: 1｜完成水电和给排水粗装，锁定浴缸冷热水、排水、溢水及检修位置。
2｜完成基层和卫生间防水，浴缸下方地面也必须纳入防水；闭水试验合格后才放行浴缸安装。
3｜用已到货浴缸和排水配件现场试放，确认完成面净尺寸、底脚／基座、排水路线、检修口，以及 DB601S-1B + QCHRG 的实际兼容性。
4｜让浴缸由自身底脚／基座稳定承重并调平，连接排水，然后进行满水试漏和排水测试；该测试是独立的施工验收节点。
5｜浴缸和排水测试通过后，再施工紧邻浴缸的瓷砖以及水磨石台面／前脸；砌筑和铺贴全过程必须保护亚克力表面。
6｜浴缸与饰面之间保留厂家要求的柔性间隙，使用卫生间防霉硅胶，不用水泥填缝；排水／溢水连接附近保留可拆检修口。

sections.title: Official Installation Data
points: TOTO NTE210 bathtub installation manual
TOTO NTE211R user and maintenance manual
DB505R-1A/1B product specification
DB505R installation manual
The floor must be waterproofed and able to drain; complete and leak-test the waste connection before enclosure.
Set the tub on a flat, rigid base with all feet bearing. Keep about 3 mm between the rim and wall finish. Do not carry the tub on its rim and do not backfill the shell with mortar.

TOTO's direct-drain reference uses a Φ40 mm drain connection with a 45-55 mm height datum; the horizontal-drain reference uses Φ40 mm, a 30-40 mm height datum and a fall of at least 1:50. The exact route must be checked against the delivered waste fitting and site drain.

The purchased DB601S-1B + QCHRG package is not yet released for concealment: the official PAY1320P specification recommends DB505R-1A/1B, so obtain a written compatibility statement or verify every mating dimension against the delivered parts before closing the terrazzo/access panel.

points: Countertop material: stainless-steel plate.
Countertop thickness: 5 mm.
Cooktop installation: the selected two-burner cooktop is to be welded to the stainless-steel countertop.
Seller note: the Q5 welded interface applies only to a 5 mm stainless-steel countertop and the welded version is recommended for installation by the stainless-steel countertop factory.
Decision source: owner confirmation on 2026-08-24, not an inference from the Q5-HJ three-burner dimensions.

sections.title: Do Not Use for Cabinet Fabrication Yet
points: Three-burner product/cutout template 950 × 370 mm.
Three-burner cabinet opening length greater than 980 mm.
Cabinet width/depth requirement greater than 490 mm.
Cabinet clear height greater than 350 mm.
Three control holes at diameter 26 mm and 150 + 150 mm spacing.
Q5-HJ left/right 5.0 kW and center 2.4 kW heat loads.
Q5-HJ timed/sniper-model socket and non-metal-door requirements.

sections.title: Fabrication Hold Points
points: Signed seller/fabricator shop drawing matching Q5-2, 哨兵定时, two-burner welded version and the final natural-gas group.
Written reconciliation of product 813 × 480, reserve 823 × 490, opening 743 × 370, R11.2 and the two diameter-26 control holes.
Weldable flange / interface dimensions and the manufacturer's written confirmation that this two-burner model supports welding to a 5 mm stainless-steel countertop.
Welding method, weld extent, distortion-control method, finishing/passivation, sealing, and post-weld inspection requirements.
Service/removal method for the burner body and controls after the countertop interface is welded.
Minimum countertop front, rear, and side edge distances.
Minimum cabinet internal width, depth, and clear height.
Whether drawers, oven, dishwasher, or shelf may be installed below it.
Final order and nameplate must explicitly show natural gas 12T; do not rely only on the generic 天然气 option label.
Gas inlet position, direction, thread/interface, and hose clearance.
Left and right burner rated heat loads and total heat load.
Ignition power: battery or mains plug.
If mains-powered: rated voltage/power, plug type, cord exit, and socket position.
Flame-failure protection type.
Ventilation/opening requirements for the cabinet below.
Whether metal cabinet doors interfere with any timer, radar, or wireless function on the exact selected model.
Installation and after-sales constraints.

sections.title: Coordination with the Y6 Range Hood
points: Align the final two-burner cooktop centerline with the Y6 range hood centerline.

The Y6 source requires the gas-burner head center to be no more than 260 mm from the finished rear wall; confirm this remains compatible with the selected two-burner cooktop's cutout and countertop rear margin.
The Y6 source recommends 300-400 mm vertically from cooktop surface to hood bottom.
Do not cut the countertop or finalize the gas point from the current images alone.

sections.title: Commercial Coordination
points: This commercial confirmation does not freeze the circuit design, point positions, quantities, materials, testing, or acceptance requirements.

sections.title: Cabinet-Maker Point Drawings — Draft Coordination Input
points: Two cabinet-supplier elevation screenshots were received on 2026-08-30: elevation 01 and kitchen elevation 02.

Elevation 01 visibly marks one socket height at 450 mm. The crop also shows 2800 mm overall height, a 900 mm base-cabinet zone and 1460 / 400 / 300 mm vertical annotations; the red 1201.2034 horizontal text requires supplier clarification.

Kitchen elevation 02 visibly marks socket-height annotations of 2200 mm, 600 mm and 1200 mm, with 450 mm horizontal offsets from the depicted left/right datums. The high point appears associated with the hood zone, but all appliance/circuit labels must be confirmed rather than inferred from the crop.

The drawings lack visible revision, scale, legend and approval fields. Before cutting chases, confirm finished-floor datum, wall datum, box-centre convention, socket type/quantity, circuit/load, accessibility after cabinet installation, and the meaning of the two unlabeled black point symbols.

The 2026-08-31 16:30 joint cabinet/water-electrical/equipment review must mark all corrections on one revision-controlled drawing and obtain cabinet supplier, water/electrical contractor and owner sign-off.
